review: bounded-resource-search-recheck@1 (handler long.bounded-resource-search-recheck, scope long-ex26, learning 1 with no study energy, prerequisites and dependencies navigate, probe and gather, package dependencies foundation-forest@1, foundation-open@1 and bounded-resource-search@1, references {} because no parameter names a target, execution duration null with cancel interruption, visualComponents [] with view metadata on every event, no satisfaction rule, process or resource, practiceEvidence its completion event, which never carries a qualified flag) is the general operation bounded resource search with optional recheck and emergency modes for any person and any known resource. Versioning: the only later package versions here (root-preparation@2 and @3) add a new interface with its own id, equivalence and handler beside version 1; v7Install refuses a repeated ability id or equivalence, nothing supersedes or retires an installed interface, assignments map a person to an ability id with the reviewed learning and mastery does not carry over, and the bounded-resource-search@1 test asserts that no other package uses its id or its event prefix, so a clean bounded-resource-search@2 is not supported and a new package was added with ability id bounded-resource-search-recheck, equivalence forage:bounded-search-and-collection:recheck-emergency:1 and event prefix search-recheck-; bounded-resource-search@1 stays byte-identical (its package hash and those of all 139 earlier packages are unchanged by an id@version map) and its module only gained an export block of aliases. Reuse: candidate collection (searchSources: perceived now through v7Observe at vision 5 or remembered by the person out of view, inside the radius, not made by another person, not left out), the lower-bound pricing (searchBinding, searchFits), the exploration choice over observed dry ground (searchPlace), the fact record (searchNote), the safety lines (searchUnsafe: health 60, satiety 8, body temperature 10 from 22, an injury in the last round) and the limits of version 1 (radius 8, path 16, time 40, energy 40, quantity 20) are its own functions and constants; every step is the dependency handler itself, once per round: the kernel navigate step v7NavigateStep (priced first on a copy of the person, at most speed x dt = 0.8 per round, distance x 2 effort raised by ground and load, and a step faster than navigate throws), OPEN_FOUNDATION.handlers open.probe in observe mode (reach, 0.2 energy, its observed-state record and event) and FOREST_BASE.handlers forest.gather (reach, real stock, 2 energy per unit, owned item); without options the operation takes the same decisions as version 1, tested round by round against it over 19 plans and 51 rounds (the same people, objects, items, processes and event identities). open-experience.ts adds the interface to the subsistence routine and to the navigate progress check only where bounded-resource-search-recheck@1 is installed, so every other run replays unchanged. Modeling assumptions: (1) recheck adds, after the sources with ripe stock, sources last seen without ripe stock, seen now or remembered by the person herself (memory.objects is written only by her own perception); a remembered place is only a navigate destination (the event view marks evidence remembered with seenAt and pastStock and never shows live stock), stock is learned only by probe within reach, and each source is probed at most once per run (inspections keep subject, tick, stock and the probe event id, and empty findings are noted and skipped); a new run, or stock seen again in perception, is new evidence; ordering is nearest reach first with ties by id; rechecks beyond the limits left are skipped rather than stopping the search, while known stocked sources beyond them still stop it as in version 1; (2) sight within vision 5 only orders candidates, as in version 1, and the harvest amount and every empty finding come only from probe; no hidden stock, unobserved source or food area out of perception is read; (3) emergency removes only the satiety <= 8 stop; health <= 60, an injury in the last round, body temperature 10 or more from 22, every limit and the reserve stay in force, the kernel still asks for a fresh decision when satiety first crosses 8, and hunger, starvation damage, temperature effects, terrain and death are unchanged; (4) minHealth (60 to 100) stops it below that value, and minTemp and maxTemp (12 to 32, min below max) bound body temperature; (5) with recheck or emergency a search for a food resource (nutrition above 0) needs a reserve of at least 1 energy, the registered cost of eat, and every step is priced above it, while the ordinary mode keeps the reserve rule of version 1 exactly; (6) avoidAreas (at most 4 circles) and avoidDirections (north, east, south, west: points within 45 degrees of that direction from the origin, north being -y) leave out sources and exploration ground there, and a navigate step that would end inside an avoided zone the person is not already in is not taken (the target is left out at no cost), so no new pathfinding is added; (7) one navigate, probe or gather step per round, each priced first against path, time, energy budget and reserve; paused rounds count toward time; another action pauses it, resume revalidates and probes again before any harvest, cancel and death end it without refunds or transfers, and carried units follow the ordinary death rules; (8) nothing is created, eaten or rewarded, and eating stays a separate eat action. In the archived round-138 world Lin can study it in one round; she sees only an empty tuber patch and a canopy tree, and every berry bush she remembers lies 20.7 to 28 away and was empty when last seen, beyond the radius 8 and path 16 limits and her 13.5 energy, so a search there completes with 0 after a little exploration; reaching them would first need ordinary rest and navigate. long-ex26-food-assessment.test.ts now asserts that its package is fourth for long-ex26 instead of last.
